structured.feedback: The response overpromises by calling the kit "Built for Beginners" when five of the eight reviews complain about difficulty and useless instructions, it doesn't clearly separate features from benefits, and its benefits are vague ("Value for Your Hair Routine", repeated "try/experiment with new styles").
